title: 14-BCV-019 - Insulation below a heated floor
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA addresses hydronic/radiant heated floors in contact with the ground and cites ABC 9.36.2.8 objective/function statements, including F92 and OE1.1.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-019 PDF, pp.1-2, PURPOSE and CODE REFERENCES

facts.text: It states minimum under-slab RSI 0.88 (R-5) where the floor is fully below the frost line and RSI 1.32 (R-7.5) where above the frost line; it says insulation is not removed.
